_about: Every use of the SERVICE-ROLE Supabase client (bypasses row-level security) in netlify/functions, with the reason it cannot use the caller-scoped `db` client. tests/security/service_role_guard.test.mjs fails the build on any use not listed here, and on entries that are no longer used. Add an entry only with a reason a reviewer would accept.

service_key_files._handler.js: Creates the per-request service-role client for makeHandler; the caller-scoped client is created alongside it.
service_key_files.client-portal.js: Public, token-authenticated client portal (no TaxStory login): reads are scoped by the portal token, checked in code.
service_key_files.video-viewer.js: Public, token-authenticated share-link viewer (no login): reads are scoped by the share token, checked in code.
service_key_files.stripe-webhook.js: Stripe server-to-server webhook (signature-verified): no user session exists.
service_key_files.reap-jobs.js: Scheduled job (no user): reaps stale audio jobs and reconciles refunds.
service_key_files.sweep-orphans.js: Scheduled job (no user): removes orphaned files and applies data-retention rules.

_handler.js.from:audit_log: Audit log is append-only system data; users must not be able to write or alter it.
_handler.js.from:profiles: getFirmProfile reads the firm's branding for server-built emails/pages; called after the auth check.
_handler.js.from:tax_returns: getTaxReturn helper also serves token-based callers; it enforces user_id === caller in code.
_handler.js.rpc:reserve_usage: Credit/projection metering is a billing control the user must not be able to call directly.
_handler.js.rpc:refund_usage: Credit refunds are a billing control the user must not be able to call directly.

_notify.js.auth:admin: Looks up the firm's login email to send 'client watched' notices (triggered by a client, not the firm).
_notify.js.from:profiles: Firm notification preferences, read on a client-triggered event.
_notify.js.from:tax_returns: Return label for the notice, read on a client-triggered event.
_notify.js.from:video_share_links: Share-link metadata for the notice, read on a client-triggered event.

_ratelimit.js.rpc:rate_limit_hit: Rate-limit counters are system data the user must not reset.

_spend.js.rpc:reserve_vendor_budget: Vendor spend cap (OpenAI/Anthropic) is a cost control the user must not bypass.
_spend.js.rpc:release_vendor_reservation: Vendor spend cap release on failure.

client-message.js.auth:admin: Firm email for the 'new client message' notice; the sender is the client (token), not the firm.
client-message.js.from:messages: Inserts an inbound message from a token-authenticated client who has no login.
client-message.js.from:profiles: Firm notification preference for the inbound-message notice.
client-message.js.from:tax_returns: Resolves the return behind the client's share token.

client-portal.js.auth:admin: Firm contact email shown in the portal; the visitor has no login.
client-portal.js.from:clients: Resolves the portal token to its client (token checked in code).
client-portal.js.from:profiles: Firm branding for the portal page.
client-portal.js.from:tax_returns: Lists the client's walkthroughs for a token-authenticated visitor.
client-portal.js.from:video_share_links: Share links for the client's walkthroughs.
client-portal.js.rpc:touch_portal: Records portal access history for the firm.

create-share-link.js.rpc:create_share_link_for: Share tokens are minted server-side so they cannot be chosen by the caller; ownership checked first.

delete-account.js.DYNAMIC: Deletes the caller's rows across every table (table list fixed in code, all filtered by the caller's id) after password re-check.
delete-account.js.auth:admin: Deleting the login itself requires the admin API.
delete-account.js.from:subscriptions: Reads the caller's Stripe subscription to cancel it before deletion.
delete-account.js.from:tax_returns: Lists the caller's returns to delete their approvals.
delete-account.js.storage:audio: Removes the caller's files (folder named by the caller's id).

generate-audio-background.js.from:jobs: Background worker (no user session) updates job progress.

generate-pdf-summary.js.from:tax_returns: Writes pdf_summary_url, a system-managed column, after the ownership check.
generate-pdf-summary.js.storage:audio: Uploads the generated PDF to the caller's folder.

generate-script.js.from:tax_returns: Writes script / script_json, system-managed columns, after the ownership check.

reap-jobs.js.from:jobs: Scheduled retention: clears finished job payloads.
reap-jobs.js.rpc:reap_stale_jobs: Scheduled: fails jobs whose worker died.
reap-jobs.js.rpc:reconcile_failed_job_refunds: Scheduled: refunds credits for failed jobs.

report-bug.js.from:feedback: Feedback is triage data users must not read or edit after sending.

save-return.js.from:tax_returns: Inserts/updates parsed_data only after server-side allow-list validation; status columns are system-managed.

save-ria.js.from:ria_projections: Writes validated projection inputs; same pattern as save-return.

save-scenarios.js.from:tax_returns: Inserts a validated scenario set (numbers only); status is system-managed.

save-video.js.from:tax_returns: Sets video_url, a system-managed column, after verifying the file exists in the caller's folder.

start-audio-job.js.rpc:start_audio_job: Charges a credit and creates the job in one transaction (billing control).
start-audio-job.js.rpc:reap_stale_jobs: Clears the caller's stuck job before starting a new one.

stripe-webhook.js.DYNAMIC: Calls the fixed set of billing RPCs (apply_subscription_state, claim/finish_stripe_event, grant_pack_credits, roll_usage_period) through one helper.
stripe-webhook.js.from:subscriptions: Looks up the subscription named in the signed Stripe event.

sweep-orphans.js.from:messages: Scheduled retention: clears recipient addresses after 90 days.
sweep-orphans.js.from:tax_returns: Scheduled: finds returns that still exist, to detect orphaned folders.
sweep-orphans.js.from:video_share_links: Scheduled retention: clears recipient addresses after 90 days.
sweep-orphans.js.from:video_view_notifications: Scheduled retention: clears recipient addresses after 90 days.
sweep-orphans.js.storage:audio: Scheduled: removes folders whose return was deleted.

video-viewer.js.auth:admin: Firm contact email for the viewer page; the visitor has no login.
video-viewer.js.from:video_share_links: Resolves and validates the share token.
video-viewer.js.rpc:record_view_event: Records view events for a token-authenticated visitor.
